authorInfo.bio: Alexandre Dumas (1824–1895) is the credited author of this historical edition. Works available in this collection include Twenty years after, Camille (La Dame aux Camilias), The Hero of the People: A Historical Romance of Love, Liberty and Loyalty. The linked author record provides further bibliographic details.

description: "Celebrated Crimes (Complete)" by Alexandre Dumas is a historical account written during the early 19th century. This collection presents a series of narratives centered around infamous historical crimes, intertwining facts with dramatic storytelling.
